title: RoomsDetectResult
description: Rooms after detection: markers for every closed A-ROOM curve, the detected outlines' stable ids, total area, and the regions left open with the reason.

ids.description: GUIDs of the room markers, drawn and detected

id.description: forsk:room_id (rd-01, …) for a detected room, the marker's name (room-01, …) for an outline drawn by hand

name.description: RoomDetect.Name: the label inside the room, else Rom. Stamped on the marker as forsk:room_name; the plan tag shows it.

x.description: The tag point, clear of walls standing in the room. Stamped on the marker as forsk:room_at; the plan tag sits there.

source.description: detected from the walls, or an outline drawn by hand on A-ROOM

rooms.description: Every room with a marker, detected first then drawn by hand: id, name, area, and the tag point. The plan tags show these records.

kept.description: Regions left to outlines already drawn on A-ROOM

removed.description: Earlier detected outlines whose region is gone

area_m2.description: Total marker area in m², one decimal

open.description: Regions left open: an undoored gap, or a space divider that meets no wall

room_id.description: The detected room the label lies in, or empty

labels_suspect.description: Labels not imported by dxf_import that look like a mangled DXF escape (B00F8ttekott). Reported as is, never guessed; the message says 'Labels suspect N (rd-..)'.

message.description: 15 rooms, 412.3 m². 1 open: gap 0.9 m without a door.
